gold: Radioiodine-refractory vesicular thyroid carcinoma (VTC) with sinonasal metastasis

selector.why: The evidence of a voluminous, pulsatile, highly vascularized mass in both nasal cavities, along with biopsy results confirming VTC metastasis, decided the diagnosis.

support_spans: voluminous, pulsatile, highly vascularized mass in both nasal cavities
Enhanced CT scan showed a hypervascular tumor in the nasal cavity, on the left thyroid, the fifth rib, and the L4 vertebra
Costal Biopsy: Pointed to VTC metastasis
Sinonasal Tumor Biopsy: Confirmed VTC metastasis
